model_kind: illustrative Python event model; NOT RTL simulation or CDC signoff
assumptions: Each unprovided acs_cdc_capt_sync is modeled as exactly TWO positive-edge flip-flops.
Both active-low resets have already initialized all registers to zero and safely released before t=0.
No metastability, recovery/removal violation, setup/hold violation, reset operation or stopped clock is modeled.
All same-domain registers sample old values and update atomically after the edge (NBA-like).
Noncoincident rising edges; din changes away from clock edges.
internal_idle is explanatory only: the pictured IP has no ready/busy output.
sampled_in_events records source-side din_re detection, NOT successfully queued or delivered transactions.
